ABOUT US

Home/About us

Training today the technicians of tomorrow.

Racines d'Avenir, vocational training institute in Yaoundé.

Racines d'Avenir is a vocational training institute. We prepare young people and adults for skilled trades through hands-on programmes lasting three to eighteen months, from BEPC to post-baccalaureate level, and we support them all the way to a job or a business of their own.

WHAT DRIVES US

One mission, one vision.

OUR MISSION

Train, support, place.

We pass on practical know-how, in the workshop and in real-life situations, so that every learner becomes a competent and independent professional. Our programmes are built around employers' needs, so the skills acquired are immediately useful in the field.

OUR VISION

Make a trade a choice for the future.

We want vocational training to be recognised and ambitious, valued by families and employers alike. The institute plans to gradually broaden its programmes and qualification levels, and to welcome learners from all over Africa in the future.

OUR SUPPORT

No one moves forward alone.

Every learner is supported from orientation to employment: an orientation test on entry, a dedicated trainer throughout the programme, an internship supervised by a mentor, CV and interview preparation, then follow-up after graduation.

The pathway in detail

EMPLOYMENT & ENTREPRENEURSHIP

Two routes to success.

After graduating, learners can join a company from our partner network or start their own business: a tailoring workshop, a hair salon, a tiling or repair business. The institute and its Foundation help them take the step.

Support for entrepreneurs

OUR VALUES

Five values, one direction.

They guide our teaching choices, our relationship with learners and our partnerships.

Commitment

We are committed to the success of every learner, with personal follow-up from orientation to their first job.

Excellence

Trainers who come from the trade, equipped workshops and programmes designed with employers, for a qualification that carries real value.

Inclusion

Young or older, women or men, with or without a diploma: everyone can find their path, including in technical trades.

Independence

We train professionals who can work in a company as well as create and grow their own business.

Solidarity

With our partners and our Foundation, we support the most motivated learners: scholarships, equipment and mentoring.

OUR TEAM

A committed team

Trainers from the trade, employment advisers, administrative staff: everyone supports learners day to day. Our trainers practise or have practised the trade they teach, and pass on its techniques, standards and realities.

Our programmes Our support Our partners

YAOUNDÉ · CAMEROON

Rooted in Cameroon, open to Africa.

Born in Yaoundé, Racines d'Avenir draws on the know-how and needs of Cameroonian businesses. Its ambition is pan-African: to train professionals able to work anywhere on the continent, and to welcome learners from across the region in the future.

A vocational training institute based in Yaoundé, Racines d'Avenir trains young people and adults for in-demand trades in construction, tailoring, beauty, services and digital technology.

Our mission: to train, support and place every learner, all the way to a job or a business of their own.
